why_relevant: Second independent aggregator of register data with per-company officer listings; valuable as a cross-check when OPTEN and the free e-cégjegyzék disagree, and its URL structure keys on cégjegyzékszám for entity resolution.

source_name: Jobline.hu (HVG group job board) - status: announced shutdown
why_relevant: Historically a major HVG-owned white-collar board; reporting found in search states operations cease 31 Jan 2026, so it is at best an archival/back-fill source. Must be validated, not assumed live.

source_name: 10times – International Payment Forum / Budapest finance events
why_relevant: Global event directory with Budapest payments-event entries, speaker snippets and exhibitor lists; a cheap discovery layer to catch conferences held in Hungary by foreign organisers that the local press ignores.

source_name: BDDSZ – Kollektív Szerződés resources (union collective-agreement library)
why_relevant: Publishes collective-agreement guidance and model texts (including a downloadable KSZ minta). Useful as a template/benchmark for interpreting bank-level collective agreements and works-council consultation duties; note this is BDDSZ, a different union from BBDSZ — an easily-confused near-homograph acronym.

entity_name: Budapest Fintech Week / Luma event listings
source_name: Budapest Fintech Week / Luma event listings
why_relevant: Luma pages for Budapest fintech-week side events publish host and speaker names with employer and role, and often an attendee-count signal; useful for early-stage/startup-side titles that never reach Portfolio agendas.

Retained executive search network with a Budapest presence; a further node for HU senior-appointment signals in financial services. Lower priority than Amrop/Stanton Chase given smaller apparent HU footprint.

entity_name: Debrecen 2030 economic development / job creation programme portal
source_name: Debrecen 2030 economic development / job creation programme portal
why_relevant: City strategy portal framing planned job-creation and regional cooperation; useful for forward-looking context on which service sectors Debrecen is actively courting (including back-office/finance) rather than for individual hiring events.

source_name: DUIHK / AHK Ungarn — German-Hungarian Chamber of Industry and Commerce
why_relevant: Largest bilateral chamber in Hungary; German-owned financial actors and IT/payments vendors are members, and the chamber publishes its Vorstand/elnökség and member directory. Reached here via the AHK network hub, which is the stable entry point to the Hungarian chapter's own domain.

source_name: ebankIT blog/press — Hungarian bank digital-channel case studies (OTP, Erste)
why_relevant: Carries dedicated pieces on OTP Bank Hungary and Erste Bank Hungary digital transformation. Even where the vendor relationship is marketing-led, the pieces quote named bank executives, which is a usable leadership/org signal for a market with no public procurement trail.

Search network claiming a BBJ-based No.1 executive-search position in Hungary. The claim itself is a marketing assertion and conflicts with the HumanField/ISG rankings seen elsewhere, which makes it a useful cross-check on how contested these HU rankings are — and a further mandate-signal node.

source_name: Glassdoor / Indeed HU – employer-review and listing pages for payments firms
why_relevant: Reveals-indirectly source: review volume, rating trajectory and self-reported office/role data act as a proxy for headcount churn and morale at Barion, Revolut HU and Wise Budapest; Indeed HU carries HU-language listings for the same employers.

source_name: Horton International Hungary — executive search Budapest
why_relevant: Global search network with a Hungary practice; another node for detecting senior financial-services mandates and appointment announcements in Budapest.
Occasional English long-form profiles of Hungarian bankers; low volume but high signal for understanding the standing and trajectory of individual executives.

Named by the BBJ/HR Portál ranking as one of the largest executive search firms operating in Hungary. Its Hungarian mandate listings and press activity indirectly indicate senior financial-services vacancies. URL form inferred from the ranking coverage — needs manual confirmation of the exact HU domain.

SME/business magazine that covers regional job-creation stories in the Southern Great Plain (Szeged region) that fall below national-daily thresholds; useful filler for the Szeged leg where dedicated banking-SSC coverage is thin.
